race.comment: AQUAHOLIC (6) has been shown good early speed of late so should look to punch up and be handy under Crowther. Fitness is no issue on the quick back-up and this looks a great chance for him to break a long run of outs. TANNENBURG (3) comes through some strong form races and should be hitting his straps fourth-up. Will likely drift back again from his draw and be warming into it late. STARGUST (4) was much better last time at Mt Gambier when sent forward, fighting on gamely to get the verdict. If he builds off that he can make it two on the bounce. KALOSYNI (10) draws to get a nice tow into the race and should be at peak fitness now on the short turnaround. Worth some thought.
